description: Introduce a static registry of OAuth behaviour implementations with Standard default and Codex customization; persist the stable behaviour ID on Connect credential metadata; expose selection in Auth Credentials and AI Credentials; route global and Person OAuth attempts through the same implementation; preserve safe account metadata; remove Codex-specific branches from central Connect OAuth. Action reuse: extend existing Connect OAuth/OAuthAttempts, credential configuration and Engine/NodeRouter operations; registry and callbacks are local-only implementation infrastructure, not Actions or agent tools. Tests: registry/default/unknown IDs, standard regressions, Codex global and Person exchange/refresh, safe metadata, persistence, and BO selection.

comments.text: Implemented static OAuth behaviour registry with Standard default and Codex customization; persisted stable auth_profile IDs; routed authorization, exchange, refresh, redirect, PKCE, and token normalization through the selected behaviour for global and Person OAuth; added allowlisted grant metadata normalization; exposed registry-backed selection in Auth Credentials and AI Credentials through Engine/NodeRouter; updated service docs and tests. Validation: focused OAuth/registry/credential/BO aggregate passed (5 properties, 436 tests); system_config_live_test passed (1 property, 206 tests); mix q passed; git diff --check passed. Final clean-DB mix precommit reached 48 doctests, 139 properties, 9442 tests with 2 failures: the accepted multi-node ConfidentialEventPeerTest peer-connect timeout and PeoplePermissionsConcurrencyTest observing committed global-suite residue. After another clean DB reset, the concurrency test passed isolated (1 test, 0 failures). The previously introduced OAuth.prepare_attempt contract regression was fixed and its isolated Jido bridge test passes.

UI review found canonical OAuth grants were still read through legacy resource-bound paths. Action reuse assessment: extend existing Connect context and Engine/NodeRouter system-config actions; Connect.list_grants remains legacy-only for Channels, while new list_grant_summaries is a secret-free canonical/legacy BO projection. Existing system_config_connect_list_grants is extended to return summaries, and existing delete/refresh actions now accept credential_id + grant_id so schemas/secrets do not cross the event boundary. No agent-tool exposure: these are trusted BO administration reads/actions. Regression scope: AI badge resolves org canonical status by AI.connect_credential_id; Person grants cannot satisfy the global badge; View Grants lists canonical rows without tokens; canonical refresh/erase still work.

title: Extract configurable OAuth behaviours
